adjudication.rationale: In Ruby on Rails applications, OpenStruct is part of Ruby's standard library and is automatically available without requiring an explicit 'require' statement. Rails autoloads the standard library, so OpenStruct can be used directly. The finding incorrectly assumes that OpenStruct needs to be explicitly required, which is not the case in a Rails application context.
